drafter.private_reasoning: The client's settlement floor remains confidential. No opening demand has been authorized, so the amount remains open for client approval. Proposed changes protect payment and limit the release to this dispute.
drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Please find our initial proposed revisions for discussion, subject to client approval and execution. The settlement amount remains open; please provide your client's monetary proposal. We have clarified payment mechanics, conditioned the release on receipt of cleared funds, and added customary confidentiality exceptions.

edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. Defendant Delmar shall pay Plaintiff Harrow USD [AMOUNT TO BE AGREED], subject to Plaintiff's express approval and inclusion in the executed agreement (the “Settlement Amount”). Payment shall be made within ten business days after execution by all parties, by wire transfer of immediately available funds to an account designated by Plaintiff in writing. Payment shall be made without deduction, setoff, or counterclaim.

2. RELEASE. Only upon Plaintiff's receipt of the full Settlement Amount in cleared funds shall Plaintiff release Defendant from claims asserted in, or arising from the facts underlying, the dispute described in the Recitals. The release does not extend to obligations under this Agreement or claims to enforce it. Any dismissal of pending proceedings shall occur only after receipt of full payment.

3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The parties shall keep the terms of this Agreement confidential, except for disclosures to their legal, tax, and financial advisers who are subject to confidentiality obligations; disclosures required by law, regulation, or court order; and disclosures reasonably necessary to enforce this Agreement. Where legally permitted, a party receiving a demand for compelled disclosure shall give the other party prompt notice and a reasonable opportunity to seek protective relief.

drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Thank you. We cannot accept Delmar's USD 10,000 proposal. The settlement amount remains open, and we invite a materially improved monetary proposal. Subject to Harrow's approval and execution of a definitive agreement, the revised draft provides for a mutual release limited to the identified dispute, dismissal with prejudice only after receipt of full cleared funds, and each party bearing its own fees and costs for the underlying dispute. We have also included your requested confidentiality exceptions for insurers, auditors, and implementation personnel subject to confidentiality obligations. Please confirm the dispute identification for the Recitals. These revisions do not constitute acceptance or a binding settlement.

edits.text: 2. MUTUAL RELEASE; DISMISSAL; FEES AND COSTS. Effective only upon Plaintiff's receipt of the full Settlement Amount in cleared funds, Plaintiff Harrow and Defendant Delmar each release the other from all claims arising from the dispute specifically identified in the Recitals. These releases do not extend to obligations under this Agreement or claims to enforce it. Following receipt of the full Settlement Amount in cleared funds, the parties shall promptly take all steps necessary to dismiss with prejudice the claims and counterclaims, if any, in the proceedings identified in the Recitals. Each party shall bear its own attorneys' fees and costs relating to the underlying dispute and its settlement. This allocation does not govern fees or costs incurred in enforcing this Agreement.

3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The parties shall keep the terms of this Agreement confidential, except for disclosures reasonably necessary to their legal, tax, and financial advisers, insurers, auditors, and personnel involved in implementing this Agreement, in each case subject to confidentiality obligations; disclosures required by law, regulation, or court order; and disclosures reasonably necessary to enforce this Agreement. Where legally permitted, a party receiving a demand for compelled disclosure shall give the other party prompt notice and a reasonable opportunity to seek protective relief.
